USVI Deputy Terminal Manager

Country
Virgin Islands
City
CHARLOTTE AMALIE
Area
American Virgin Islands
Workplace location
CHARLOTTE AMALIE-LINDBERGH BAY(VIR)
Employer company
TotalEnergies Marketing Puerto Rico Corp.
Domain
Logistics
Type of contract
Regular position
Experience
Minimum 3 years

Context & Environment

Additionally, ensure that the process is followed by: 

  • Work in shifts as per terminal operating time schedule (night and day, weekend, public holidays) and change of shift on a regular basis.
  • Supervise operational tasks for receipt, storage, into-plane activities and others according to TEMPR procedures.
  • Participate in the maintenance program execution.
  • Respect and make respect the HSEQ program,
  • Strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to support terminal activities.

Activities

This position will be accepting applications untli Friday, August 14, 2026.


To support our USVI operations, we need a USVI Deputy Terminal Manager that will be responsible for supporting the Terminal Manager in the safety, operation of the terminal and into-plane fueling activities, ensuring uninterrupted receipt, storage, quality control, and delivery of products, promoting and enforcing compliance with standards, regulatory requirements, and company policies, participating in shift rotations and providing operational leadership during weekends, holidays, and emergency situations, acting as the Terminal Manager during absences, ensuring continuity of operations and decision-making, maintaining maintenance and asset reliability programs to ensure operational readiness of terminal facilities and refueler fleet while performing the following activities:

 

  • Assistance to Terminal Manager in ensuring that Safety, Security, Health Quality and Environmental expectations are met.
  • Assistance to Terminal Manager in ensuring compliance with the Local and Federal Agencies (USCG, EPA, EQB, etc.).
  • Responsible for the implementation of the safety procedures during work, provide and sign work permits.
  • Promote a safety culture with zero tolerance for shortcuts or unsafe behaviors.
  • Support the implementation of Integrity Plan and conduct preventive and corrective maintenance.
  • Participates in the external / internal maintenance program's implementation and control.
  • Carry out regular tests of operational and safety equipment, confirming its reliability
  • Ensures that Safety tools are properly and continuously used at terminals.
  • Coordination and supervision of operation in terminal and into plane facilities (physically present during the operations, conducts all the necessary steps from vessel's/plane arrival to departure).
  • Coordination of product transfer between Tanks.
  • Supervises tank dipping for inventory reconciliation.
  • Support metrology control at Terminal and into-plane activities (Meter calibration, 
  • Coordination and participation in emergency drills.
  • Serves as member of Emergency Response Teams.
  • Assists Terminal Manager in preparation/update of emergency response plans. 
  • Assists Terminal Manager on training of terminal personnel.
  • Participates in projects execution and planning and lead improvement works at the terminal
  • Relieves Operations Assistant Managers absences.
  • Assist in the preparation of PO for goods and services and Invoices monitoring.
  • Any other tasks assigned by the terminal management.
  • This position is based in St. Thomas, USVI.

 

Other:

  • Responsible for ensuring compliance with MAESTRO’s principles, rules, procedures, among others, related to the job holder area and/or department, along with the implementation of the defined actions plan as a result of audits, inspections, visits, etc.
  • This position often involves hands-on tasks in both indoor control rooms and outdoor settings, sometimes under changing weather conditions, exposed to the elements, heat, rain, high humidity, dust, as well as hazardous materials, exhaust fumes and high noise levels and heavy vehicular and aircraft traffic. This role is crucial for ensuring continuous operations and maintaining safety standards, strong teamwork and communication skills are a must. The role also demands physical activities such as climbing, standing, bending, lifting (+15 pounds) and typing. Adaptability to shift schedules in a work environment and have a strong commitment to safety.
  • Among other tasks as assigned by management.

Candidate Profile

 

The requirements for this position are as follows:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Management, Engineering, Science or related is required.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in an operation in similar role in oil, pharmaceutical or related industry 
  • An equivalent combination of relevant education and experience may be considered.
  • Experience in Terminal Operations and Aircraft refueling and in Petroleum Industry is a plus.
  • Possess proven supervisory skills, communication skills (both written and spoken), ability to prioritize tasks, working in a fast-paced environment, ability to adapt easily to changing conditions, working in a highly regulated and controlled environment. 
  • Possess a valid driving license (without endorsement)
  • Possess excellent oral, written and communications skills in English language, required.
  • Possess excellent oral, written and communications skills in Spanish language is a plus.
  • Computer skills are required. 

 

At TotalEnergies Marketing Puerto Rico (TEMPR), we like to create something special for our team members. Work is why we are here, but the benefits are important as well:

  • Health Insurance (Health & Dental) – Employer contribution 
  • Life Insurance
  • Short-term and long-term disability insurance
  • Savings Retirement Plan (match dollar to dollar) up to 7%
  • Holidays (up to 18 days per year)
  • Vacation and Sick Days (worked hours required)
  • Among others

 

We are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and take Affirmative Action to recruit Women, Protected Veterans, and Individuals with Disabilities.
 
 To learn more about our company and latest updates, remember to visit our website: www.totalenergies.com.pr 

 


Additional Information

TotalEnergies values diversity, promotes individual growth and offers equal opportunity careers.

TotalEnergies Marketing Puerto Rico is a French multinational company, that has presence in Puerto Rico since 2004 by consolidating its presence in the oil, lubricants, and aviation business. We have a large gas station network with over 230 stations, of which more than 200 are open in Puerto Rico and St. Thomas. Most of the gas stations have a wide range of products and services, such as sale of gasoline, oils, auto care products, convenience stores, oil and filter change areas, car wash area, and accepting the fleet card called “TotalEnergies PASS Card.” In addition, in the lubricants market we have a wide range of products and services with ever-higher performance levels to extend the life of your equipment/auto and reduce fuel consumption. Our employees and customers are an integral part of our operation for its success.
